caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or fabric sample with an intricate and symmetrical design. The pattern is composed of horizontal bands running across the fabric, filled with repeating motifs such as flowers, swirls, leaves, and geometric shapes. The design features three primary colors: green, blue, and pink, with some elements outlined or accented in brown. The bands alternate in color and each contains different ornamental motifs, with some bands having stylized leaves and floral forms, while others contain different abstract or curvilinear shapes. Along the right and bottom edges, there is a border formed by a set of adjacent bands, perpendicular to the main bands, featuring similar motifs. The fabric sample is set against a plain, light background, which contrasts with the intricate and colorful design. The overall shape of the textile is rectangular, and the drawing focuses solely on depicting the fabric sample without any additional objects or details in the surrounding space.
title: Homespun Bedspread
